annotation.bound_parties_text: The notice directs city/prefecture economic and information commissions, relevant industrial parks and relevant enterprises, and all levels of industrial authorities and units, to implement the plan.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: 全省各级工业主管部门、各有关单位、园区及企业要进一步提高对加快工业机器人产业发展的认识
annotation.robot_provision_quote: 湖南省经济和信息化委员会关于印发《湖南省工业机器人产业发展规划（2014-2020年）》的通知
